breakdown.rationale: Physical accessibility is described qualitatively (ramps/lifts, most branches on ground floor or with elevators) but no percentage of accessible premises is given, and no digital accessibility measures (screen-reader support, accessible app/website) are disclosed.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose the percentage of branches/offices that are physically accessible and describe any digital accessibility measures such as website/app screen-reader support.

breakdown.rationale: A named 'Equal Opportunity Policy' under the RPwD Act 2016 is described, covering non-discrimination and employment opportunities for PwD, but no concrete accommodation-request process or response-time commitment is described.
breakdown.recommendation: Describe a concrete workplace-accommodation request and fulfillment process for PwD employees.

breakdown.rationale: Reports a precise headcount of differently-abled employees (898 total; 688 male, 210 female; all permanent) with percentage breakdowns for FY2025-26.
No recruitment targets, PwD-specific hiring outreach, or attainment figures are disclosed.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose whether the bank sets PwD hiring targets tied to the RPwD Act 2016 quota and report attainment against them.

breakdown.rationale: No attrition, tenure, or promotion data specific to PwD employees is disclosed.
breakdown.recommendation: Report attrition/retention rates specifically for differently-abled employees.

breakdown.rationale: No data on PwD representation in senior/management roles is provided; Board and KMP disclosures do not reference disability status.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose PwD representation at management/leadership levels.

breakdown.rationale: Training tables cover health & safety and skill upgradation for all employees but do not mention any disability-sensitization or PwD-specific training program.
breakdown.recommendation: Introduce and disclose a disability-sensitization/awareness training program for staff.

breakdown.rationale: No ongoing culture practices (ERGs, flexible work arrangements, accommodation response-time commitments) specific to PwD employees are described beyond the general non-discrimination policy statement.
breakdown.recommendation: Describe ongoing inclusion practices such as PwD employee resource groups or flexible-work accommodations.

breakdown.rationale: Grievance and POSH complaint data reported is general and not broken out for PwD employees; no PwD-specific satisfaction or grievance data is disclosed.
breakdown.recommendation: Publish grievance/satisfaction data specific to PwD employees.

breakdown.rationale: The filing affirms accessibility of branches/offices under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, but does not quantify the percentage of compliant premises or report attainment against the statutory PwD employment quota.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose the specific percentage of branches/offices meeting RPwD Act 2016 accessibility standards and report attainment against the statutory PwD employment quota.
